name: The Prince Of Darkness
source:
MYSTERY ROMANCE

A being who has existed since the beginning, seeking the memories of his past life. He hides his true form from everyone. To uncover his story, you must play again and again.

[From [url=https://how-to-grow-a-man.fandom.com/wiki/The_Prince_Of_Darkness]How to Grow a Man Wiki[/url]]
